Your LDL Cholesterol result is 172 mg/dL.
Your report has an "H" flag next to this number, which means it is high and sits above the printed reference

range. 

LDL stands for low-density lipoprotein. It carries cholesterol through your blood to your body's cells. It is
often called "bad" cholesterol because having extra LDL can cause plaque to build up in your blood vessels over time.
